mapper.select: WITH class_rows AS ( SELECT one_class_no AS class_no, one_class_name AS class_name, '0' AS parent_class_no, 1 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE one_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(one_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT two_class_no AS class_no, two_class_name AS class_name, one_class_no AS parent_class_no, 2 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE two_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(two_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT three_class_no AS class_no, three_class_name AS class_name, two_class_no AS parent_class_no, 3 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE three_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(three_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT four_class_no AS class_no, four_class_name AS class_name, three_class_no AS parent_class_no, 4 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE four_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(four_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT five_class_no AS class_no, five_class_name AS class_name, four_class_no AS parent_class_no, 5 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE five_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(five_class_no)) <> '' ) SELECT DISTINCT class_no AS classNo, class_name AS className, parent_class_no AS parentClassNo, class_level AS classLevel FROM class_rows WHERE class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(class_no)) <> '' ORDER BY class_level, class_no

SELECT s.class_no AS classNo, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.class_sku)), '')), 0)) AS INT) AS suggestSaleSku, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.sys_suggest_sale_sku)), '')), COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.class_sku)), '')), 0))) AS INT) AS sysSuggestSaleSku, MAX(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.class_role))) AS roleNo FROM base_class_sku s LEFT JOIN base_department d ON d.store_no = s.store_no WHERE s.class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(s.class_no)) <> ''
GROUP BY s.class_no

SELECT class_no AS classNo, CAST(MAX(sale_sku) AS INT) AS saleSku FROM category_sale_sku_summary WHERE class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(class_no)) <> '' AND store_no =
#{param.storeNo} N'__ALL__'
AND store_format_no =
#{param.retailTypeId} N'__ALL__'
AND business_circle_no =
#{param.businessCircleId} N'__ALL__'
AND store_group_no =
#{param.deptGroupId} N'__ALL__'
GROUP BY class_no
mapper.update: IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_class_sku WHERE store_no = #{storeNo} AND class_no = #{classNo} ) BEGIN UPDATE base_class_sku SET class_role = #{roleNo}, class_sku = CAST(#{suggestSaleSku} AS NVARCHAR(40)), sys_suggest_sale_sku = CAST(#{sysSuggestSaleSku} AS NVARCHAR(40)), updatetime = GETDATE() WHERE store_no = #{storeNo} AND class_no = #{classNo}; END ELSE BEGIN INSERT INTO base_class_sku ( store_no, store_name, store_org_no, store_org_name, store_format_no, store_format_name, business_circle_no, business_circle_name, store_group_no, store_group_name, class_no, class_name, class_sku, sys_suggest_sale_sku, class_role, updatetime ) SELECT d.store_no, ISNULL(d.store_name, ''), d.preorgcode, d.preorgname, d.store_format_no, d.store_format_name, d.business_circle_no, d.business_circle_name, d.store_group_no, d.store_group_name, #{classNo}, cls.class_name, CAST(#{suggestSaleSku} AS NVARCHAR(40)), CAST(#{sysSuggestSaleSku} AS NVARCHAR(40)), #{roleNo}, GETDATE() FROM base_department d CROSS APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 class_name FROM ( SELECT one_class_name AS class_name FROM base_class WHERE one_class_no = #{classNo} UNION ALL SELECT two_class_name AS class_name FROM base_class WHERE two_class_no = #{classNo} UNION ALL SELECT three_class_name AS class_name FROM base_class WHERE three_class_no = #{classNo} UNION ALL SELECT four_class_name AS class_name FROM base_class WHERE four_class_no = #{classNo} UNION ALL SELECT five_class_name AS class_name FROM base_class WHERE five_class_no = #{classNo} ) t WHERE class_name IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(class_name)) <> '' ) cls WHERE d.store_no = #{storeNo}; END
mapper.select: SELECT class_no AS classNo, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(class_sku)), '')), 0)) AS INT) AS suggestSaleSku, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(sys_suggest_sale_sku)), '')), COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(class_sku)), '')), 0))) AS INT) AS sysSuggestSaleSku, MAX(LTRIM(RTRIM(class_role))) AS roleNo FROM base_class_sku WHERE store_no = #{storeNo} AND class_no = #{classNo} GROUP BY class_no

SELECT d.dict_code AS dictCode, t.dict_id AS dictId, d.dict_sort AS dictSort, d.dict_label AS dictLabel, d.dict_value AS dictValue, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), d.create_time, 120) AS createTime FROM sys_dict_data d LEFT JOIN sys_dict_type t ON t.dict_type = d.dict_type AND t.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = N'000000' AND d.dict_type = #{dictType} ORDER BY d.dict_sort ASC, d.dict_code ASC
